experience.summary: Contributing to production-grade business applications with ownership across backend services, Angular interfaces, Azure cloud deployment, AI integrations, and system reliability.
description: Delivered end-to-end product features across enterprise web applications, covering API design, Angular UI development, data modeling, deployment support, and production issue resolution.
Built AI-assisted capabilities using the OpenAI API, including personalized sales outreach generation and maintenance report root cause analysis to improve user productivity.
Developed secure and scalable REST APIs with ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, LINQ, SQL, PostgreSQL, and MySQL for core workflows such as work orders, assets, inventory, and sales engagement.

Automated Azure infrastructure provisioning with Bicep across App Services, databases, Redis, storage, Key Vault, and service integrations, improving environment consistency and deployment reliability.
Implemented asynchronous communication and background processing using MassTransit, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, and Hangfire to support resilient long-running workflows.
Integrated Twilio calling, voicemail, and voice greeting features into the sales platform, helping teams manage customer communication from one connected product experience.
Handled Chrome extension deployment activities and supported Gmail CASA Tier 2 security compliance requirements for application integrations.
Performed web application vulnerability scanning with OWASP ZAP and helped improve application security by identifying, validating, and addressing security risks.
Worked closely with product, QA, and engineering teams in Agile ceremonies, code reviews, and release activities to ship maintainable features with professional engineering standards.
